items.originalTitle: Arvid Lindblad praised for "class" response after Liam Lawson Azerbaijan GP clash
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad has received overall praise from Formula 1 fans following his media pen apology to team-mate Liam Lawson after their collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛上与利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞后，阿维德·林德布拉德因“有风度”的回应受到称赞
阿维德·林德布拉德向小红牛队友利亚姆·劳森道歉后，赢得了F1车迷的赞誉
小红牛新秀阿维德·林德布拉德在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上与队友利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞后，在媒体采访区向对方道歉，随后整体上获得了F1车迷的称赞。
在巴库，车队本有望冲击强劲的双车得分完赛，但临近结束时的一次安全车重启引发了中游集团的混乱。进入1号弯时，林德布拉德刹车锁死，撞上了劳森赛车的左侧。
这次碰撞导致劳森的赛车底板受损。这位新西兰人当时在车队电台里说：“老兄，我可真爱被队友撞出比赛，真是太爽了。”
林德布拉德最终以第七名完赛拿到六个积分，而劳森只获得第12名。
后来有人看到这位英国人在媒体采访区向劳森道歉。
一位车迷在 Reddit 上评论道：“利亚姆的内心独白：我现在正在接受采访，别在这个扯淡的解释面前发作……别发作……然后……喝一口……好……把火气咽下去。”另一位车迷则补充说：“在媒体采访区道歉真是一招战术，因为在那里劳森没法对他发作。聪明人。”
利亚姆·劳森，小红牛，阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛
其他人称赞了这次互动，称这是一次很有风度的举动。有人发帖说：“看起来非常尴尬，但我很高兴林德布拉德主动承担了责任。可以看出劳森依然非常恼火。”另一个人写道：“显然是他的失误，确实有点不幸。不过双方都做出了很有风度的回应。”
还有网友发帖说：“嗯，不管怎样，这看起来相当真诚。且不论时机是否合适，这可能确实是事情发生后他们第一次见面。”
进一步的反应包括：“林德布拉德今年表现出了令人难以置信的成熟，”以及“劳森内心肯定还在愤怒，但阿维德至少敢于承担局面，值得称赞。”
劳森目前在车手积分榜上以59分排名第九，林德布拉德以37分排名第十一。小红牛（小红牛）在车队总冠军争夺中以83分排名第五，领先排名第六的阿尔派15分。
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad praised for "class" response after Liam Lawson Azerbaijan GP clash
Arvid Lindblad earned praise from Formula 1 fans after apologising to Racing Bulls team-mate Liam Lawson
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad has received overall praise from Formula 1 fans following his media pen apology to team-mate Liam Lawson after their collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

The team was in contention for a strong double-points finish in Baku before a late safety car restart triggered chaos in the midfield. Heading into Turn 1, Lindblad locked his brakes and made contact with the left side of Lawson's car.
The impact caused floor damage to Lawson's machinery. "Man I love getting taken out by my team-mate. That's pretty sick," the New Zealander said over the team radio at the time.
While Lindblad went on to secure six points with a seventh-place finish, Lawson finished 12th.
The Briton was later seen apologising to Lawson in the media pen.

"Liam's inner monologue: I'm doing media right now, don't lose it at this bs explanation... don't lose it.... and... drink... OK... swallow the anger," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "Tactical doing it in the media pen where Lawson can't blow up at him. Smart man."
Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

Others praised the interaction, describing it as a "class" move. "Looked so incredibly awkward but I’m glad Lindblad owned it. You can tell Lawson is still pissed af," someone posted, and another wrote: "Obviously his mistake, it was a bit unfortunate, however. Class response from both."
Someone else posted: "Well, it looked pretty genuine anyway. Whether that's the right time or not, it's probably the first time they've seen each other since it happened."
Further reactions included: "Lindblad has been looking incredibly mature this year," and "Lawson is definitely still raging internally, but fair play to Arvid for at least owning the situation."

Lawson currently sits ninth in the drivers' standings with 59 points and Lindblad is 11th with 37 points. Racing Bulls is fifth in the constructors' championship with 83 points, 15 points ahead of Alpine in sixth.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛的赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛充满戏剧性：队友相撞、世界冠军呼吁禁赛某车手、车手胜利荒终结、顶尖车队复苏以及回归车手登上领奖台。本文分析了谁表现最好、谁表现最差。
items.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix featured team-mates colliding, the world champion calling for a driver to be banned, a win drought broken, a top team resurgent and a returnee on the podium. This piece analyses who came out best and worst.
detailZh: 队友相撞、世界冠军呼吁禁止一名车手参赛、连胜荒被打破、一支顶级车队强势复苏、还有一位回归车手登上领奖台——2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上可谓精彩纷呈。
以下是我们对谁表现最好、谁表现最差的看法。
在蒙扎展现出一些令人鼓舞的迹象之后——弗朗哥·科拉平托在那里速度很快但出现了失误——又在马德里赛道上比阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利更快，并且可以说交出了他进入F1以来最好的一个比赛周末——结果他却干了蠢事，把这一切都毁了。
有几位车手公开为他辩护。卡洛斯·塞恩斯指出了巴库赛道棘手的轮胎状况、脏污的赛道以及发动机怪异的动力输出，而阿尔维德·林德布拉德则批评了安全车重启的处理方式。
但最终，科拉平托是唯一一个把两个前轮都锁死、并同时撞上两辆车的人。当其中一辆车是你队友的车时，你就真的麻烦了。他至少承担了“全部责任”——尽管在这种情况下他其实也没有别的选择。
由于他无法接受赛事干事判给他的10秒时间处罚，这将意味着他在雪邦要接受发车位置处罚。— 本·安德森
从几乎稳拿双车积分，到因为科拉平托一次重大的刹车误判，最终酿成双车退赛的灾难性结果，前后不过一瞬。
对于阿尔派（阿尔派）来说，这最终是本周末的一个灾难性结局，此前他们刚打造出加斯利所称的“我们今年目前为止最好的赛车”。
科拉平托把加斯利和诺里斯的迈凯伦一起撞出比赛，这不仅让阿尔卑斯至少损失了他们在事故发生前所持有的七个积分，还间接造就了林德布拉德接手加斯利原来的第七名的机会，使小红牛在车队年度总冠军争夺战中与阿尔卑斯争夺第五名的差距扩大到15分。—— BA
2024年4月21日。要追溯到这个日期，才能找到红牛上一次双车登上领奖台的记录，那就是维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔在巴库以第二、三名完赛的这次。对于一个尽管遭遇种种困境、却显然始终是F1顶尖强队之一的车队来说，这个数据简直是荒谬的。
这是哈贾尔升入红牛一队以来我们见过的最佳表现之一——他本人也承认，这是他“第一次在这个车队真正度过一个非常干净的周末”——考虑到这是他伤愈复出后的第一个比赛周末，这就更加令人印象深刻了。
他在缠斗中十分高效，在维斯塔潘逼近时清楚地理解了任务，并且像职业选手一样执行了车队战术。甚至连他的无线电通话听起来都比平时缓和了一些。
如果他是想向红牛展示自己缺阵期间车队错过了什么，这可真是一个再好不过的方式了。——杰克·科曾斯
这个周六，1号弯对迈凯伦来说简直像是恶意针对：两次冲出赛道加上一次撞车，导致车队在本该轻松击败动力受限的法拉利、拿到积分的周末颗粒无收。
诺里斯整个周末都显得不顺（受某个问题限制速度，而且明显状态也不佳），所以在同一弯角他自己已经因冲出赛道搞砸了比赛之后不久，又与阿尔派撞车，这简直是为一场糟糕透顶的比赛画上最后一个屈辱的句号。
他对科拉平托的失误毫不留情地进行了评价，但同时也对自己的比赛感到不满。
"以我当时拥有的速度，我在场上毫无机会，"他哀叹道。"当然，在驾驶方面确实有一些我做得不够好的地方，我需要看看下次能改进什么，但同时，他们超越我时展现出的速度，那是根本不可能追上的。所以这基本上是一项在场上不可能完成的任务。"
但队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在争夺领奖台的战斗中表现出色，直到一次奇怪的双前轮锁死让他名次大幅下滑。
"我不觉得我做了什么特别的事导致锁死，"他思索道。"显然我当时走的路线和平时不同，因为我在防守，所以不知道是不是正好压到了路面的隆起或什么东西，但这对我来说确实很意外。" —— 瓦尔·霍罗恩日
乔治·拉塞尔从杆位出发赢得胜利，他形容这是"我职业生涯中最具统治力的一个周末"，这印证了他自八月休赛期以来反复提及的进步。
毕竟，虽然排位赛中争冠对手安东内利在一号弯撞墙，等于给了拉塞尔一次畅通无阻的机会，但拉塞尔本身速度确实很快，而且看起来他对自己的梅赛德斯队友本来就有速度优势。
拉塞尔说："我为今年艰难时期自己和身边的工程师团队所展现出的韧性感到非常自豪，因为为了克服一些挑战、让我的驾驶风格更好地适应这辆新车，我们付出了大量的努力。F1竞争如此激烈，你没有机会去练习这些。
"而且现在，这些驾驶感觉比以前更直觉化了，我的信心也在增强。尤其是在这样的赛道上，它能让你在刹车时多榨出那么一点点，让赛车离墙更近一点，这是一个完美的周末。" —— 埃德·斯特劳
正赛最快圈速通常是用来看比赛表现的糟糕指标，但博塔斯的最快圈速比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢了1.5秒，这确实反映出了我们所看到的这场比赛的差距。
甚至在比赛末段那次撞车之前——那次事故被归因于更早在1号弯冲出赛道触发了能量回收系统故障，“系统有点混乱”——他的表现就已经糟糕得让人摸不着头脑。
“这是一场漫长的比赛，”博塔斯坦承。“说实话，完全没有速度。我只能和费尔南多（阿隆索）竞争。我们在那里确实损失了一些时间，但除此之外也差得很远，所以这个周末有很多东西需要研究。”
“差得很远”还是说得轻了——博塔斯第一次进维修区时已经落后佩雷斯将近一分钟，所以不管问题是什么，都相当严重——这必须是他自己和凯迪拉克要优先解决的头等大事。——VK
就速度而言，这是维斯塔潘和红牛最强的一个周末，尽管动力单元处于劣势，他最终只落后冠军拉塞尔0.2秒，这证明了红牛正在取得的进步。
尽管如果他本应从前排发车，而不是因为动力单元问题从第八位发车，他的夺冠机会可能会更大，但维斯塔潘怀疑，无论如何他也很难做得比第二名更好。
"即使我从第二位发车，我认为乔治的节奏也会很难被超越，"维斯塔潘说。
但红牛在阿塞拜疆是真正的冠军争夺者（这在2026年很罕见），而且从本应发车的位置起步可能带来胜利的可能性令人心动，这对维斯塔潘来说是一个急需的提振。—— ES
在卡洛斯·塞恩斯最初排位第九后被罚退五位之后，亚历克斯·阿尔本获得了向队友复仇的机会，因为他在第二节排位赛被淘汰了。
他在3号弯撞车前一直守在第13位，把奥康压在身后，当时他刹车锁死，径直撞上护墙。塞恩斯则在早段进站掉到第19位后强势回归，最终拿回一个积分。
阿尔本称这次事故很“奇怪”。他认为可能是阵风加上威廉姆斯赛车在重刹时会抬起一个车轮的特性共同导致了事故，不过他仍然承认自己需要为此担起责任。
错失了一个大好机会，尤其是超越队友的机会，而他的队友这个周末一再从逆境中反弹。——杰克·贝尼翁
在马德里赛道和阿塞拜疆巴库的二练中接连撞车之后，林德布拉德带着信心不足的状态进入这场比赛，尽管方式并不完美，但他在周日的正赛中领跑中游集团并斩获大把积分，将是一次很好的提振。
首先，是那个无法回避的问题：第39圈安全车重启时，他与小红牛车队的队友利亚姆·劳森发生了碰撞。
林德布拉德声称奥孔“基本上在刹车时变线”，所以他“不得不采取避让动作，这导致我的前轮轻微锁死，然后撞上了利亚姆”。
无论这些辩解理由是否属实（从回放画面来看，奥孔似乎并没有这样做），林德布拉德都逃脱了处罚，并在混乱中意外地从中获益。
他还批评了发车时的松散以及起跑编队组织不当的问题，导致车手们反复地加速又刹车。
detailEn: Team-mates colliding, the world champion calling for a driver to be banned, a win drought broken, a top team resurgent and a returnee on the podium - there was plenty going on in Formula 1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Here's our take on who came out best and worst.

After a couple of encouraging signs at Monza - where Franco Colapinto was fast but made errors - and Madring - where Colapinto was quicker than Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and arguably executed his best weekend yet in F1 - he went and spoiled it all by doing something stupid.

A few drivers spoke out in his defence. Carlos Sainz addressed the tricky tyres, dirty circuit and weird power delivery of the engines in Baku, while Arvid Lindblad criticised the way the safety car restarts were handled.

But ultimately Colapinto was the only one to lock both front wheels and clatter into two cars at once. When one of those cars is your team-mate's you really are in trouble. He at least took "full responsibility" - not that there was much else he could do in the circumstances.
And because he couldn't serve the 10 second time penalty the stewards gave him, that will mean a grid penalty for Sepang. - Ben Anderson
From looking odds on for a double points finish to actually achieving a catastrophic double DNF in the space of one major Colapinto braking misjudgement.
This was ultimately a disastrous conclusion to the weekend for Alpine, after producing what Gasly called "the best race car we've had so far this year".

Colapinto wiping out both Gasly and the McLaren of Lando Norris not only robbed Alpine of at least the seven championship points they were holding before it all went wrong, it also created the conditions for Lindblad to bag the seventh place Gasly was holding and extend the gap Racing Bulls holds over Alpine to 15 points in their battle for fifth in the constructors' title race. - BA

April 21 2024. That's how far you have to go back for Red Bull's most recent double podium before Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar's 2-3 finish in Baku. It's frankly an absurd stat for a team that, despite its troubles, has so obviously remained among F1's top operators throughout that time.

This was as good a performance as we've seen from Hadjar since his graduation to the senior team - he acknowledged as much, saying it was the "first time with the team that I actually get to do a very clean weekend" - all the more impressive considering it came on his first weekend back from injury.

He was effective in battle, understood the assignment when Verstappen closed up to him, and played the team game like a pro. Even the radio messages felt like they were a little less terse than usual here.
If he was looking to show Red Bull what it had been missing while he was out, this was a damn good way to do it. - Jack Cozens
Turn 1 felt as if actively malicious to the McLarens this Saturday, with two offs and one crash that meant zero points on a weekend the team really should have outscored the power-limited Ferraris.

Norris seemed up against it (speed-limited by an issue but also clearly just in a bit of a funk) throughout the entirety of the weekend, so took the crash with the Alpines - shortly after he'd messed up his own race already by visiting the run-off at the same corner - as a final insult to cap off a miserable outing.
He was unsparing in his assessment of Colapinto's error, but also just unhappy about his race.

"I had no chance out there with the speed I had," he lamented. "Sure there were some things I wasn't doing well enough in driving and I need to see what I could improve next time, but at the same time, the speed that they came past me, that was impossible. So it was a pretty impossible task out there."
But team-mate Oscar Piastri was doing stellar work in the fight for a podium until it was undone by a strange lock-up of both fronts that sent him down the order.

"I didn't think I did anything spectacular [to cause it]," he mused. "Obviously I was on a different line to what I normally would be, defending, so I don't know if I was on a crown in the road or something, but it certainly was a surprise to me." - Val Khorounzhiy
George Russell's victory from pole position, which he described as "the most dominant weekend I've had in my career" validates the progress he's spoken repeatedly about making since the August break.

After all, while he was given a clear run by title rival Kimi Antonelli clipping the Turn 1 wall in qualifying, Russell was genuinely quick and looked to have a pace advantage over his Mercedes team-mate anyway.

"I'm very proud of the resilience that I and my close group of engineers have shown during the tough periods this year, because there's been a lot of hard work to overcome some of the challenges to adapt my driving style to suit this new car better," said Russell. "F1 is so tough you don't get opportunities to practice this.

"And finally, it's coming to me a bit more intuitively than it once did, and I'm gaining confidence. And especially on circuits like this, it just allows you to eke out that little bit more on the brakes, get that little bit closer to the walls, and it's been a flawless weekend." - Edd Straw

Fastest race lap is usually a rubbish metric to measure performance in an F1 race, but Valtteri Bottas's being 1.5s down on what Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez managed does seem reflective of the race we saw.

Even before his crash at the end of the race - attributed to a harvesting glitch triggered by an earlier off at Turn 1, as "the systems got a bit confused" - the performance was properly, head-scratchingly miserable.

"A long one," Bottas admitted. "Just, honestly, no pace at all. I could only fight with Fernando [Alonso]. For sure, we lost some time there, but otherwise just pretty far off, so lots of things to look into from this weekend."

"Pretty far off" is an understatement - Bottas was nearly a minute down on Perez at the time of his first pitstop, so whatever was wrong was very wrong - and has to be a huge priority for himself and Cadillac to figure out. - VK

This was Verstappen and Red Bull's strongest weekend in terms of pace and the fact he finished just two tenths of a second behind winner Russell despite a power unit disadvantage is proof of the progress Red Bull is making.

While his victory chances might have been boosted had he started where he should have done on the front row, instead of eighth thanks to a power unit problem, Verstappen suspects that it would have been difficult to have done better than second anyway.
"Even if I started second, I think the pace of George would have been very hard to pass," said Verstappen.

But the fact Red Bull was a genuine victory contender in Azerbaijan (a rarity in 2026) and the tantalising possibility that starting where he should have done could have led to victory, is a much-needed boost for Verstappen. - ES
After Carlos Sainz was given a five-place penalty having initially qualified in ninth, Alex Albon was given the chance to avenge the defeat from his Williams team-mate, given he was dumped out in Q2.

He was keeping Esteban Ocon behind in 13th when he crashed at Turn 3, locking up and heading straight into the wall. Sainz recovered from dropping to 19th with an early stop to come back and score a point.

Albon said the incident was "odd". He reckoned a combination of a big wind gust, and the Williams car's characteristic of raising a wheel under heavy braking, could have caused the incident, although he still acknowledged his need to hold his hands up for it.
A big opportunity missed, especially to outperform his team-mate, who repeatedly bounced back from adversity this weekend. - Jack Benyon

After consecutive crashes in FP2s at the Madring and in Baku, Lindblad was struggling for confidence entering this race, and even though it wasn't the perfect way to do it, leading the midfield and bagging big points in Sunday's race will be a nice boost.
First, the elephant in the room, his contact with team-mate Racing Bulls Liam Lawson on the lap 39 safety car restart.
Lindblad claimed Ocon "basically moved under braking" so he "had to take avoiding action which meant I locked the front slightly and I hit Liam".
Whatever the accuracy of those mitigating circumstances (a review of the angles suggested Ocon wasn't doing so), Lindblad escaped unpunished and inadvertently benefitted from the chaos.
He also criticised the slackness of the start and how it was poorly formed up, causing drivers to accelerate then brake repeatedly.

塞恩斯为他辩护，指出巴库轮胎棘手、赛道脏且引擎动力输出怪异。
林布拉德则批评了安全车重启的处理方式。
keyPointsEn: Colapinto had shown encouraging signs at Monza and Madring, where he was quicker than Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly.
Carlos Sainz defended him, citing the tricky tyres, dirty circuit and weird engine power delivery in Baku.

items.originalTitle: Alpine's Flavio Briatore rips into Franco Colapinto's Baku blunder: "A very poor move"
items.summaryEn: Alpine executive Flavio Briatore said he was extremely disappointed by the team's double DNF at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, criticising Franco Colapinto for a very poor move that took out team-mate Pierre Gasly.
detailZh: 阿尔派 的弗拉维奥·布里亚托利痛批弗兰科·科拉平托在巴库的失误：“一次非常糟糕的操作”
阿尔派 一级方程式主管弗拉维奥·布里亚托利对弗兰科·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上撞掉队友皮埃尔·加斯利的行为明显感到不满。
阿尔派 一级方程式高管弗拉维奥·布里亚托利对车队在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上双车退赛感到“极度失望”，并批评弗兰科·科拉平托撞掉队友皮埃尔·加斯利是“一次非常糟糕的操作”。
在第 36 圈的重启时，科拉平托在巴库街道赛道多尘、抓地力低的内侧锁死了前轮，猛烈撞上皮埃尔·加斯利的赛车侧面，导致两名车手都退出了比赛。迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯也被卷入这次事故，这使 阿尔派 失去了一次几乎到手的积分双收。
加斯利和诺里斯都对科拉平托的驾驶感到不满，后者甚至呼吁国际汽联考虑对这种鲁莽的驾驶行为实施一场比赛的禁赛。
科拉平托的老板布里亚托利也明显不为所动，毫不避讳地批评了这位阿根廷车手。
布里亚托利在阿尔派的赛后新闻稿中被引述说："显然，我对今天比赛的结果感到 极其失望，要知道我们在争夺总冠军的路上丢掉了宝贵的积分。"
"这类事故本不该发生，尤其是当时我们的两辆赛车都跑在积分区内、状态很好的时候。我为车队感到非常抱歉，也为皮埃尔感到遗憾，他整个周末都表现得非常出色。同时我也要向兰多和迈凯伦道歉，因为我们毁了他们的比赛。"
“我知道弗朗哥已经承担了全部责任，这也是他应该做的；事实上，考虑到比赛的情况和安全车重启的时机，他刹车刹得太晚了。对于一名有他这种经验的车手来说，这是一个非常糟糕的举动。”
弗朗哥·科拉平托，阿尔派；皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
布里亚托利表示，他会在这次事件之后考虑接下来的措施，以避免将来重蹈覆辙。“我想花时间好好反思一下，考虑应该采取什么行动，这样我们才能从中吸取教训，避免将来再出现这样的情况，”这位意大利人说道。
科拉平托在巴库的失误，发生在这位23岁车手正处于他在F1迄今为止最佳状态时期之后，这一出色表现也为他赢得了阿尔派的新合同，将在2027赛季继续与加斯利并肩效力于这支位于恩斯通的车队。
detailEn: Alpine's Flavio Briatore rips into Franco Colapinto's Baku blunder: "A very poor move"
Alpine Formula 1 chief Flavio Briatore was distinctly unimpressed with Franco Colapinto taking out his team-mate Pierre Gasly in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix

Alpine F1 executive Flavio Briatore has been left "extremely disappointed" with his team's double DNF in F1's Azerbaijan GP, criticising Franco Colapinto for "a very poor move" to take out team-mate Peirre Gasly.

On a lap 36 restart, Colapinto locked his front tyres on the dusty, low-grip inside of the Baku street circuit, slamming into the side of Pierre Gasly, taking both drivers out of the race. McLaren driver Lando Norris was also collected in the incident, which robbed Alpine of a likely double points finish.
Both Gasly and Norris were upset with Colapinto's driving, with the latter even going as far as calling for the FIA to consider a one-race ban for careless driving behaviour.
Colapinto's boss Briatore was also distinctly unimpressed and didn't shy away from criticising the Argentinian.
"Obviously I'm extremely disappointed with the outcome of today's race, knowing we lost valuable points in the Championship fight," Briatore was quoted in Alpine's post-race press release.

"These sorts of incidents shouldn't happen, particularly when we were running well with both cars in point-scoring positions. I feel very sorry for the team and for Pierre who did a great job all weekend and my apologies also go to Lando and McLaren for ruining their race.

"I know that Franco has taken full responsibility for it, as he should; in fact, he braked far too late considering the context of the race and the safety car restart. It was a very poor move for a driver of his experience."
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine

Briatore said he would consider his next steps after the incident to avoid a future repeat. "I want to take time to reflect on it and consider what course of action should be taken, so we can learn from it and avoid such a situation in future," the Italian said.

Colapnto's Baku blunder comes after the 23-year-old had been enjoying his strongest spell of form in F1 to date, earning him a new Alpine deal for the 2027 season to remain alongside Gasly at the Enstone-based team.

detailZh: 基米·安东内利：F1积分榜领先者表示，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上因缺乏信心而“开得像自己的奶奶一样”

Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli says that the Azerbaijan GP was 'one of those days you have to be happy with P5' but adds that he will be 'back at my level' at the Malaysian Grand Prix.
World championship leader Kimi Antonelli says he was driving "like his grandmother" during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix because of a lack of confidence at the Baku City Circuit.

Antonelli staged a decent recovery in Saturday's race to come from 16th on the grid, following a crash in qualifying, to finish fifth, but his championship lead over his Mercedes team-mate George Russell was reduced to 66 points as the Brit claimed victory.

The 20-year-old Italian has shown remarkable consistency to build a commanding lead at the top of the standings, but struggled in Baku after missing a significant chunk of practice due to technical issues with his car.

Expectations were high given Antonelli had remarkably come from 19th on the grid to win his home race at Monza earlier in September, but his progress was far more steady this time around.
"If I had the same pace as at Monza or in previous races, it would have been different," Antonelli said.

"It would have been like just full attack. But today, I realised very early that first of all, it was a lot harder to overtake with a train of cars all in Overtake Mode, then I didn't have the same pace as I had previously, so the mindset changed very quickly."

Antonelli actually dropped a place at the start, and it took him 17 laps to work his way up into the top 10.

He then benefitted from errors made by drivers ahead as he made further progress. He also survived a near-miss at the first of two rolling restarts following Safety Cars as he avoided a crash that took three cars out of the race, and was able to continue despite contact with the Haas of Oliver Bearman.
Antonelli said: "After the restart, I had big floor damage. My whole left side was gone with the contact.
There was carnage on the safety car restart after contact between Alpine team-mates resulted in Lando Norris crashing out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
"After that, the car was very sketchy to drive, and I still tried to get to P4, but all in all, it's one of those days where you have to be happy with P5.
"Also seeing so many people doing mistakes, you kind of pull back a little bit because I just took advantage of everyone else's mistakes and just move forward."

Russell produced his most complete weekend since the opening round of the season in Australia, taking a victory that would have been dominant without the Safety Car interruptions.
The Azerbaijan GP saw a dramatic ending as Valtteri Bottas crashed on the final lap as George Russell just beat Max Verstappen to victory by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli remains a heavy favourite for the title, especially given Russell must take a grid penalty for changing his engine between now and the end of the season.
It was therefore unsurprising that the championship leader was retaining a positive outlook ahead of the next race.
"It's exciting," Antonelli told Sky Sports F1. "George has done an incredible weekend, he's driven incredibly. He had a lot of confidence.
"And this weekend was my worst of the year by far in terms of performance. I wasn't there, I wasn't really present, especially with what happened so early on."

items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly was taken out by his Alpine teammate Franco Colapinto at the restart of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, lamenting the loss of many points. The crash cost Alpine crucial points in its battle against Racing Bulls.
detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利感到“被压垮了”，因为弗朗哥·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上把他撞出了比赛。
在巴库，阿尔派的车手们发生相撞，导致车队在与小红牛的争夺中损失了关键积分
“我简直不敢相信，这么多积分就这么没了……”
皮埃尔·加斯利对F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛重启时发生的连环相撞事故的最初反应说明了一切。
加斯利在整个比赛中一直领跑中游集团，当亚历山大·阿尔本撞车引发的安全车干预结束时他排在第七位，队友弗兰科·科拉平托位居第十，而对手小红牛的车手则落在第十二和第十四位。
然而，科拉平托在弯道内侧犯下了极其严重的锁死失误，这位阿根廷车手在1号弯撞上了自己的队友，把队友的赛车撞向兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦——三名车手全部退赛。
巧合的是，小红牛的两辆赛车也在同一时刻发生了碰撞，但阿维德·林德布拉德被干事认定没有任何过错，并最终在终点线上抢下第七名。因此这造成了13分的差距波动——在车队积分榜上，阿尔派目前落后排名第五的对手15分，而不是根据第35圈时的排位本可能只落后2分。
“在这样一个如此强势的周末、如此强势的比赛之后，我们对这个结果都非常失望，”加斯利说。“我感觉赛车的状态非常好。速度几乎和刘易斯一样快，和兰多也一样。”就在第30圈阿尔本撞车退赛之前，加斯利落后汉密尔顿6秒、落后诺里斯3秒，领先基米·安东内利3秒、领先科拉平托13秒。
“所以，我一直和他保持着三秒的差距，直到[诺里斯]在一号弯锁死轮胎，之后我们领先身后的弗兰科有15秒的优势。我是说，刚才发生的事情仍然让人难以消化。”
兰多·诺里斯（迈凯伦）、皮埃尔·加斯利（阿尔派）
尽管他在蒙扎夺得了杆位，加斯利认为阿尔派的A526在正赛条件下从未有过如此强的竞争力。
“说实话，我觉得这是我们今年到目前为止最好的正赛赛车，从某种意义上说这是积极的，”他说。“但与此同时，当你获得这些拿大分数的机会时，你必须把握住。遗憾的是，今天没有做到。”
当被问及对科拉平托的道歉是否感到满意时，这位法国车手沉默了几秒钟。
“怎么说呢，我很失望，”他最终回答道。“如果你问我，我对今天的表现并不满意。”
加斯利不愿指责领跑的乔治·拉塞尔在重新发车时造成的混乱，而是更倾向于指出一级方程式的新动力单元可能对这位梅赛德斯车手的做法产生了影响。
“乔治想怎么做就怎么做，这取决于我们自己……”他开始说道。“显然当时我们的车挤得很紧，但以我们现在的发动机以及电池、能量回收等方面的限制，你在能做什么这件事上其实并没有太多自由。所以我对他[在重新发车时拖得比较晚]并不感到惊讶。”
加斯利现在打算通过“好好睡上一觉”和“在家里过一个周日”来调整状态，争取最早在下周的马来西亚大奖赛上实现反弹。
detailEn: Pierre Gasly feeling “crushed” after Franco Colapinto took him out of Azerbaijan GP
Alpine lost crucial points in its battle against Racing Bulls as its drivers crashed into each other in Baku
“I cannot believe it, so many points gone...”
Pierre Gasly’s initial reaction to the pile-up that occurred at the restart of Formula 1’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix said it all.

Gasly led the midfield throughout the race and was seventh when the safety car intervention caused by Alexander Albon’s crash ended, with team-mate Franco Colapinto 10th, while the rival Racing Bulls were down in 12th and 14th.

However, a monumental lock-up from Colapinto on the inside saw the Argentinian careen into his team-mate in Turn 1, sending the sister car into Lando Norris’ McLaren – all three drivers retired from the race.

As it happens, the Racing Bulls collided at the same time, but Arvid Lindblad was cleared of any wrongdoing by the stewards and went on to snatch seventh place on the finish line. That was therefore a 13-point swing – Alpine is 15 points down on its fifth-placed opponent in the constructors’ championship, instead of a potential two based on the lap-35 classification.

“We're all very disappointed with the outcome after such a strong weekend, strong race,” Gasly said. “I was feeling very good with the car. The pace was almost as good as Lewis and same as Lando.” Shortly before Albon crashed out on lap 30, Gasly was six seconds behind Hamilton and three adrift of Norris, leading Kimi Antonelli by three and Colapinto by 13.
“So, keeping up the three-second gap with him until [Norris] locked up in Turn 1, then we had a 15-second margin with Franco behind. I mean, it's still difficult to process what just happened.”
Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
Although he took pole position in Monza, Gasly believes Alpine’s A526 had never been so competitive in race conditions.

“To be fair, I think that's the best race car we've had so far this year, which in a way is positive,” he said. “At the same time, it's like, when you get these chances to score big points, you've got to make it happen. And sadly it didn't happen today.”
Asked if he was happy with Colapinto’s apology, the Frenchman remained speechless for a few seconds.
“I mean, crushed,” he ended up replying. “If you ask me, I'm not happy about today.
Gasly didn’t want to blame race leader George Russell for the mess at the restart, preferring to point out how F1’s new power units may have contributed to the Mercedes driver’s approach.

“George does whatever he wants to do, and it's up to us to...” he began. “Obviously we were quite bunched up, but with the engines we have and the limitations we have with battery, harvest, etc., you're not really that free in what you can do. So I wasn't really surprised for him to [leave the restart quite late].”
Gasly will now aim at “a good night’s sleep” and “a Sunday at home” to bounce back as early as next weekend in Malaysia.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli "driving like my grandmother" in Baku F1 race
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli recovered from 16th on the grid to finish fifth in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after hitting the wall in qualifying, explaining that he took a cautious approach in Baku.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在巴库F1比赛中“开得像我奶奶一样”
基米·安东内利解释了他谨慎的驾驶方式，他在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上从第16位 recovery 到了第五名。
如果说基米·安东内利在蒙扎那场惊艳的逆转夺冠是一段载入史册的驾驶，那么他在巴库街头赛道上这场平淡得多的后续表现，只是他刚起步的职业生涯中的一个注脚。
在排位赛中擦撞护墙之后，安东内利面对的是三周之内第二次从发车区第16位发车、再向前追赶的比赛。虽然全长6公里的巴库城市赛道确实比F1上一站马德里赛道提供了更多超车机会，但安东内利心里清楚，想要重演他在蒙扎的英雄表现，往好里说也是一项艰巨的任务，往坏里说则是一个不可能实现的目标。
在这条充满陷阱、风力强劲且难度极高的街道赛道上，安东内利采取了谨慎的策略，逐步超越中游车手，上升到第八位，直到第31圈（共51圈）亚历克斯·阿尔本引发了安全车。
在已经受益于兰多·诺里斯在一号弯冲出赛道之后，这次中断为安东内利的追分之旅带来了又一次急需的助推，因为它让所有赛车重新聚拢到一起，而这位20岁的车手还获得了进一步的帮助：弗兰科·科拉平托撞上了诺里斯和队友皮埃尔·加斯利，而这辆梅赛德斯车手竟然奇迹般地躲过了这场混乱。
这为挑战法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿打开了大门，安东内利以第五名冲过终点线，在艰难的一个周末之后成功完成了一轮止损。
赛后，安东内利承认自己开得像他的意大利'奶奶'一样小心翼翼，因为他试图减少输给夺冠队友拉塞尔的分数。
“我今天开得有点像我祖母，纯粹是在保护赛车防止损坏，”安东内利解释道。“你知道的，我就是没有冒险。在做出动作之前，我都会先确保自己能够完成这个动作。”
梅赛德斯的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯
虽然安东内利在重启时成功避开了科拉平托引发的混乱，但他还是被哈斯车手奥利弗·贝尔曼撞到，导致左侧底板边缘受损。
“重启之后，我的底板受损严重，”安东内利详细说明。“碰撞让我整个左侧都毁了。所以在那之后，这辆车开起来非常难以驾驭。我仍然尝试去争取第四名，但总的来说，这就是那种只能对第五名感到满意的日子。”
"我看到阿尔派锁死了车轮，就立刻收了回来。我正准备做反打线路，但显然我没料到奥利会那么快从内线冲上来。我很幸运没出事，但很不幸运地带走了这么大的损伤。"
在这个混乱的周末之后——练习中出现液压泄漏，排位赛中又撞车——安东内利对自己的表现感到失望。正是这种速度和节奏的缺失，让他在比赛中采取了更加谨慎的策略。
"如果我有在蒙扎或之前几场比赛中那样的速度，情况会不一样，"他解释道。"那就会是全力进攻。但今天我很早就意识到，首先，在一串车全都处于超车模式的情况下，超车要困难得多。而且我也没有之前那样的速度。
"心态很快就变了。而且看到这么多人犯错，你也会稍微收一收。因为今天我只是利用了其他所有人的失误，然后不断向前。"
由于他 recovery 至第五名，将积分损失限制在拉塞尔身上仅 15 分，安东内利在 F1 前往马来西亚之际，带着 66 分的健康领先优势离开巴库。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli "driving like my grandmother" in Baku F1 race
Kimi Antonelli explains his cautious approach as he recovered from 16th to fifth in Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix
If Kimi Antonelli's sensational Monza comeback win was a drive for the ages, then his much more subdued encore in the streets of Baku was just a footnote in his fledgling career.

After tagging the wall in qualifying, Antonelli was facing his second comeback race in three weekends from 16th on the grid. But while the 6km Baku City Circuit certainly offered more passing opportunities than F1's previous stop in Madrid, Antonelli was aware a repeat of his Monza heroics was always going to be a tall order at best, and an impossible goal at worst.

On the tricky and windy street circuit, which was laced with pitfalls, Antonelli employed a cautious approach as he gradually picked off midfielders to move up to eighth by the time Alex Albon caused a safety car on lap 31 of 51.

Having already benefitted from Lando Norris' off in Turn 1, the neutralisation gave Antonelli's recovery drive another much-needed shot in the arm as it brought the field together, and the 20-year-old received further assistance when Franco Colapinto took out Norris and team-mate Pierre Gasly and the Mercedes driver somehow managed to escape the carnage.
That opened the door for a challenge on Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton as Antonelli crossed the line in fifth, completing a successful round of damage limitation after a tricky weekend.
Afterwards, Antonelli conceded he was driving like his Italian 'nonna' as he tried to reduce the points loss to winning team-mate George Russell.
"I was driving a bit like my grandmother today, just damage save mode," Antonelli explained. "You know, I just didn't take a risk. Before making a move, I was making sure that I could go for it."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Carlos Sainz, Williams
While Antonelli did manage to avoid Colapinto's melee at the restart, he was swiped by Haas driver Oliver Bearman which caused damage to the left-hand side floor edge.

"After the restart, I had big floor damage," Antonelli detailed. "My whole left side was gone with the contact. So after that, the car was very sketchy to drive. I still tried to get to fourth, but all in all, it's one of those days where you have to be happy with fifth.

"I saw the Alpine locking up and I pulled back immediately. I was getting ready to do the switchback, but then obviously I didn't see Ollie coming so quickly on the inside. I was lucky to get away with it, but not so lucky to come away with such a big [amount of] damage."

Following a disrupted weekend with a hydraulic leak in practice and a crash in qualifying, Antonelli was left disappointed with his own performance. It's that lack of pace and rhythm that instructed his more cautious approach to the race.

"If I had the same pace as at Monza or in previous races, it would have been different," he explained. "It would have been just full attack. But today I realised very early that, first of all, it was a lot harder to overtake with a train of cars all in overtake mode. And then I didn't have the same pace as I had previously.

"The mindset changed very quickly. And also seeing so many people making mistakes, you kind of pull back a little bit. Because today I just took advantage of everyone else's mistakes and just moved forward."
Having limited his points loss to Russell to 15 points courtesy of his recovery to fifth, Antonelli leaves Baku with a healthy 66-point lead in the standings as F1 heads to Malaysia.
